snippet.title: My Pet Hooligan | Official Cinematic Trailer | Game
snippet.description:
Long oppressed, they were forced into servitude for their evil overlord MetaZuckBot, the CEO of ZuckCorp. Then came rebellion. Freed, they embraced newfound liberty and unleashed their inner Hooligan. They came as one, united by a mission to disrupt MetaZuckBot's rule but their path to freedom led to division, birthing seven separate factions, among them the Hare Raisers, Cypherbuns, Mutants and more. United by a mission, yet divided by rivalry. Dive into the Rabbit Hole. 

Your goal: obliterate ZuckCorp. The stage is set. Will you heed the call?

Whether you prefer engaging in fierce combat, wreaking havoc on the environment, showcasing your skateboarding skills like a pro, leaving your mark with graffiti on buildings, or simply chilling with friends, being a Hooligan means playing the way you want.

Play My Pet Hooligan Early Access for free now and unleash your inner Hooligan! https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/my-pet-hooligan-453949

Join our community:
Website: https://mypethooligan.com/
X: https://twitter.com/mypethooligan
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mypethooligan/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@mypethooligan
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/mypethooligan

ESRB RATING: Teen with Crude Humour, Drug Reference and Fantasy Violence.

Director: Jon McDonald
Producer: Jumanah Shaheen
